transcript.text: Hello, I'm here to help you get ready for your appointment. Could you tell me what has been bothering you?
I've had sinus congestion and drainage for the last several days. It's been bothering me, but otherwise I feel well overall.
Could you tell me how much the congestion and drainage is affecting your daily life, and whether you have any allergies or bad reactions to medicines?

It hasn't really slowed me down much — I feel well overall and still walk 1–2 miles most days, at the local mall when the weather is bad. I don't have any allergies or bad reactions to medicines that I know of.

Could you tell me about any medicines you take regularly or have recently started or changed—including the name and dose if you know it—and any past health problems, long-term conditions, operations, or hospital stays?

I was diagnosed with diabetes last fall. I take something for it, but I'm sorry, I can't remember the names or the doses. As for operations or hospital stays, I haven't had any that I recall, and I've never smoked.
On a scale from 0 to 10, with 0 being no trouble at all and 10 being the worst you can imagine, how would you rate the congestion and drainage at their worst?
It's more of a nuisance than anything — I'd put it at about a 3 out of 10 at its worst. It hasn't kept me from doing my usual activities.

Can you tell me how the congestion and drainage tend to come and go over time, and what kinds of things—like your activities, positions, foods, medicines, or anything else—seem to make it better or worse?
I haven't really noticed it following any particular pattern — it's just been there for the last several days. I can't say that anything in particular makes it better or worse.
Thanks — that's really helpful. Is there anything else you've noticed or would like to mention that we haven't talked about yet?

The only other thing is that I get up once a night to pass urine. I haven't had any abdominal pain, nausea, vomiting, diarrhoea, constipation, or blood in my urine or stools, and I haven't noticed any swelling in my ankles.
What worries you most about what’s been going on, and what are you hoping we can help with today?
Honestly, I'm not overly worried — I feel well overall. Mostly I'd just like to get this sinus congestion and drainage cleared up, and make sure everything's on track with my diabetes.
Besides your diabetes, are there any other ongoing health problems or past illnesses you think we should know about?
No, I don't have any other ongoing health problems or past illnesses that I know of. My diabetes is really the main thing.
Could you describe what the sinus congestion and drainage feel like for you?
It's a stuffy, blocked-up feeling in my sinuses, and there's drainage that runs down the back of my throat. It's uncomfortable, but not severe.
Along with the sinus congestion and drainage, is there anything else you’ve noticed, or anything else you’d like to add?
Well, since you ask — my mammogram is up to date, I see my gynaecologist regularly, and I check my feet regularly for my diabetes. I can't think of anything else.
Thank you, that is very helpful. I have put together a short summary of what you told me. Please read it and tell me if anything should be corrected before it goes to your doctor.
